signals.title: Shake That Hill: Eldoria 2026
signals.reason: Open-air summer festival with daytime arts, craft corners, and grassy meadow space around the base of the hill for kids to run safely.
signals.note: Confirmed on the official Shake That Hill website (shakethathill.com) for August 28–30, 2026.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.reason: Expansive outdoor museum featuring dozens of real aircraft and helicopters where a 4-year-old can roam free and gaze up at giant machines.

signals.title: Bubbu Bear Children's Center & Park Zone
signals.reason: Safe, fenced play centre with seasonal outdoor inflatable attractions, soft play areas, and shaded relaxation for parents.

signals.title: Frigopan Horse Base Pony Rides
signals.reason: Clean and modern equestrian centre offering guided pony walks and friendly animal viewing suited for younger children.

signals.title: Fantasy NeMuseum
signals.reason: Hands-on sensory museum with colorful interactive installations and analog play where children are encouraged to touch and explore everything.

signals.title: Lane closure and bus detours on Blvd. Peshtersko Shose for heating pipe works
signals.location: Blvd. Peshtersko Shose (between ul. Tsarevets and ul. Raya), Zapaden district, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Direct traffic disruption and public transit reroutes affecting major west Plovdiv thoroughfare.
signals.note: Confirmed via EVN Bulgaria announcement regarding heating pipe maintenance in Plovdiv.

signals.title: Public hearing on the delayed 2026 Plovdiv Municipal Budget (€400M)
signals.reason: Major local governance milestone with €102M allocated for capital infrastructure spending, announced following national fiscal delays.
signals.note: Could not verify a specific public hearing for the municipal budget on these dates.

signals.title: Construction begins on 80-decare Kan Krum Park renovation in Trakia
signals.location: Kan Krum Park, Trakia district, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Durable city development adding over 1,000 trees, walking paths, security infrastructure, and an event stage in a €5M green transformation.
signals.note: Confirmed by Plovdiv Municipality (plovdiv.bg) regarding the Kan Krum Park reconstruction project.

signals.title: Overcoming Gravity: Atanas Patsev Centenary Exhibition
signals.reason: Curated fine art retrospective of a prominent Bulgarian modernist painter; completely visual with zero language barrier.
signals.note: Confirmed on the Plovdiv City Art Gallery official website (galleryplovdiv.com) listings for Hall 2019.

signals.title: Molec – 'Where...' Live Tour Concert
signals.reason: Large-scale live open-air performance by Bulgaria's top contemporary indie pop/alt act at the Roman amphitheatre.
signals.note: Confirmed on Eventim.bg for the Molec concert at the Ancient Theatre.

signals.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
signals.reason: High-production musical staging of Sondheim's classic thriller in the open-air Roman venue.
signals.note: Confirmed on Eventim.bg for the Sweeney Todd performance at the Ancient Theatre.

signals.title: Shake That Hill: Eldoria 2026 Urban Arts & Music Festival
signals.reason: Multi-stage open-air urban festival covering electronic, funk, and street culture in a relaxed outdoor hill park setting.
signals.note: Confirmed on the official Shake That Hill website (shakethathill.com) for August 28–30, 2026.

signals.title: Bunardzhik Hill Sunset Viewpoint
signals.reason: Easily walkable central climb with panoramic sunset views over the Thracian plain; no booking required and entirely language-neutral.
